create.name: Anja Steensig
create.bio:
Anja Steensig is a Danish writer, speaker and spiritual mentor who teaches what she calls Nordic Mysticism: a direct, personal relationship with God, understood as love, without church, guru or set method. For well over ten years she was one of Denmark's familiar television and radio faces, hosting her own talk show and winning a public vote as the country's best female presenter. A profound personal crisis in 2011 turned her life around, and after some seven years of quietly learning from that experience she began sharing what she had found.

Her teaching is deliberately plain and undogmatic, centred on surrender, prayer, forgiveness and keeping the heart open in everyday life. She teaches through online programmes, including the six-module Nordic Mysticism course and a seven-part on-demand course made with The Shift Network, and through talks and workshops she has given in several European countries. Her book of prayers and reflections, Book of Solace, was published by DeVorss in 2023 and won a gold COVR Visionary Award. She takes on a small number of people for one-to-one mentoring and shares longer guided meditations on her YouTube channel, LoveBeing.

books.title: Book of Solace: Love and Light for Dark Days
books.author: Anja Steensig
books.description: A collection of short prayers, poems and reflections published by DeVorss, written to lead a discouraged reader back to the love within. It won a gold COVR Visionary Award in 2024.

courses.title: The Path of the Nordic Mystic
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand video course made with The Shift Network. Anja teaches her way of meeting God directly through the heart, with practices to carry into daily life.

courses.title: Nordic Mysticism
courses.description: Her own six-module online programme of video sessions and practices, with a year's access. It is framed less as a course than as an invitation to rest in love and listen for your own inner guidance.

courses.title: 1:1 Heart to Heart mentoring
courses.description: Private spiritual mentoring with Anja, offered to a small number of people at a time. Enquiries go to her by email.
